----------------------------------------------------------------
ABOUT THE ROLE
----------------------------------------------------------------

Northwind Analytics is looking for a Machine Learning Engineer to join our
applied research group. You will own retrieval-augmented generation systems end
to end, from ingestion through evaluation.

----------------------------------------------------------------
REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
----------------------------------------------------------------

- 3+ years of professional Python development
- Hands-on experience with retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)
- Solid grounding in vector search and embedding models
- Experience with a document parsing stack such as pdfplumber or Unstructured
- Ability to design and evaluate LLM-backed systems, not only prototype them
- Comfortable with SQL and SQLite for data modelling

----------------------------------------------------------------
NICE TO HAVE
----------------------------------------------------------------

- Experience with local model serving (for example Ollama or llama.cpp)
- Familiarity with answer-generation evaluation, including faithfulness checks
- Exposure to applicant-tracking-system form automation and dry-run validation
- Experience writing deterministic parsers alongside model-based extraction

----------------------------------------------------------------
RESPONSIBILITIES
----------------------------------------------------------------

- Build and maintain document ingestion pipelines for PDF, DOCX, and plain text
- Design retrieval strategies and measure recall against labelled question sets
- Build evaluation harnesses that compare prompts and models reproducibly
- Write deterministic code for anything that must be reproducible and auditable
- Collaborate with product engineers on API design and data contracts
- Review AI-generated output before it reaches an end user

----------------------------------------------------------------
TECHNOLOGIES
----------------------------------------------------------------

Python, Pydantic, SQLite, pdfplumber, python-docx, Ollama, pytest

----------------------------------------------------------------
NOTE ON AUTOMATION SAFETY
----------------------------------------------------------------

This synthetic posting deliberately includes a line about form automation so
tests can confirm the system treats browser automation as out of scope for the
foundation phase. No real application submission is part of this phase.
